data.name: Between Worlds
data.detailed_description:
IMPORTANT INFORMATION:

We currently offer a free version available as a demo, so anyone can enjoy the game at no cost.

We have also decided to release this version for a symbolic price, for those who wish to support the project and its future development. It is the same experience available in the free demo and does not include additional content. Purchasing it is simply a way to contribute and help us continue working on the game.

We want to be completely transparent:
It is not necessary to make any purchase to play.
Your support—whether financially, by sharing the game, or by leaving a review—is truly appreciated and helps us a lot.

Thank you for being here and for being part of this adventure!

BETWEEN WORLDS:

Between Worlds is a fantasy metroidvania platformer where you accompany MAT, a young man trapped in a mysterious school shrouded in strange magic. In your quest to understand what has happened, you will discover new abilities alongside MAT and face challenges that will test your wits, reflexes, and emotions.

Between worlds with their own rules:

Change worlds, change the rules: switch between dimensions to modify the environment, the skills available, and the challenges to overcome. So, if you can't continue along one path, change the world around you to avoid that obstacle or overcome it with new tools.

Fight magical creatures, complete forgotten puzzles, and explore incredible worlds.

More than just a simple journey between platforms:

In each world, MAT must learn to adapt to his new abilities and the challenges they present, growing as the adventure progresses. Between Worlds offers an introspective journey into maturity, identity, and the emotions that transform us, accompanied by vibrant and emotional aesthetics.

data.short_description: MAT is a young boy trapped in a school he barely recognises. Help him in the search for answers, shifting between worlds, uncovering new challenges, creatures, and abilities in each of them. Explore a narrative platformer inspired by the metroidvania genre, made by friends for friends.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10/11 (64 bits)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / GTX 1650 or equivalent (4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated sound card
